text:
anya: quick sync — did a bring-up today: mistralx-40b (8-bit quant) + speculative decode on staging, prefetch-window=6.

mohit: nice. any perf numbers?

anya: median latency down ~22% (220ms -> 172ms), p95 about the same. token cost ~ -18%.

kai: quality? perplexity or weird regressions?

anya: small ppl regression on commons-basic-200 (+0.9 ppl) but more concerning: intermittent prefix-staleness/hallucination when prefetch hits a boundary — early tokens repeat or drift.

sasha: example? paste one.

anya: example output (truncated):
```
Input: "Summarize the policy changes"
Output: "The policy changes are aimed at improving transparency. The policy changes are aimed at improving transparency. The company will..."
```

kai: ugh — looks like cached KV misalignment. seen similar in 4-bit where quantization smooths attention and prefetch picks wrong continuation.

mohit: any runtime errors? logs?

deploy-bot: deploy complete: shard cluster-7, model mistralx-40b-8bit-spec. logs: /ops/logs/1777777777 (search kv-sync)

anya: logs show repeated warnings: "kv-sync-mismatch at pos=27; recovering by fallback" then fallback path produces repeated phrase.

sasha: hypothesis: quant changes attention weights; speculative prefetch chooses a branch then cache isn't fully flushed on fallback so stale KV used.

kai: mitigation ideas: reduce prefetch window, enable strict-kv-check (validate cache before reuse), or do a quick temperature/soft-calibration to rebalance probs.

mohit: propose targeted A/B: window=4 vs window=6 on 500 examples from commons-basic-200. collect ppl, top5-KL vs fp16 baseline, repeat-rate, mean latency. seeds 42/99.

anya: kicking off AB now. commands:
```bash
run_onboard --model mistralx-40b-8bit --speculative true --prefetch-window 4 --ab-group A --samples 500 --seed 42
run_onboard --model mistralx-40b-8bit --speculative true --prefetch-window 6 --ab-group B --samples 500 --seed 42
```

mohit: add distribution compare:
```bash
python tools/compare_dist.py --baseline fp16 --candidate 8bit --metric top5_kl
```

sasha: also dump logits for first 64 tokens for 100 examples so we can inspect token-prob shifts.

anya: quick results for seed=42: group A (window=4) ppl delta +0.2, repeat-rate 0.8% (was 1.9% with no mitigations), median latency +3ms. group B (window=6) repeat-rate 2.1%. top5-kl for A = 0.012, B = 0.018 vs fp16 baseline.

kai: window=4 looks like best tradeoff (small perf hit, much fewer repeats).

mohit: recommended actions before rollout: 1) default prefetch-window=4 for 8-bit quant models 2) add strict-kv-check opt-in for quant models 3) add regression alert: repeat-rate > 1% on commons-basic-200 triggers rollback.

sasha: strict-kv-check measured overhead?

anya: strict-kv-check adds ~6ms median but drops repeat-rate to ~0.3% in experiments.

kai: rollout plan: canary 5% traffic on Dedicated with window=4 + strict-kv-check; monitor repeat-rate and p95 latency for 24h. success criteria: repeat-rate < 1% and p95 < baseline + 10%.

mohit: approved. rollout config to repo: canary:0.05, prefetch_window:4, strict_kv:true.

sasha: I'll hook repeat-rate and top5-kl into Redwood Console (per-model dashboard) and add eval hooks for model-version.

anya: drafting follow-up doc with examples, logs, and recommended defaults; will link to onboarding checklist. tagging @eng-oncall for awareness.

mohit: thanks everyone. next experiment: try float16 layers for attention + quant-aware scaling over weekend to see if we can keep window=6 without staleness.

(emoji reactions omitted)
